requirements.evidence: All contract pieces are present: Queues properties/methods (app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:22-256), accessQueue/accessGrants view data scoped through $entity->queues()->find (Queues.php:220-236), Serve state + callNext with InactiveQueue/NoWaiting notices, uncaught AuthorizationException and rate limiting (Serve.php:53-88), members tabs with role="tablist" and setActiveTab whitelist (Members.php:68-75), routes (routes/web.php:59-60), nav links (default-page.blade.php:49-56) and every lang key in both locales. Rename re-derives slug via Str::slug (Queues.php:139-144). Deviation: the task says CallNextTicket(..., CallMode::from($mode)) but callMode() uses `CallMode::tryFrom($this->mode) ?? CallMode::Any` (Serve.php:154-157), so a tampered mode silently calls in `any` mode.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes go through CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket, authorization via $this->authorize and QueuePolicy, #[Validate] on name/renameName with validateOnly, #[Locked] on entity and lastCalledTicketId, CHANGELOG/docs/architecture.md/business-rules.md updated, sibling style of members page (row buttons, Bulma modals). Minor deviations: Serve::$mode carries #[Validate] but validate() is never called (Serve.php:35); four near-identical modal-card blocks in queues.blade.php are not extracted into a Blade component; repeated inline styles.

security.evidence: Every client id is re-resolved via $this->entity->queues()->findOrFail / memberships()->findOrFail and authorized (Queues.php:97-213, Serve.php:62); render uses find() scoped to the entity plus Gate 'call' check so tampered ids disclose nothing (Serve.php:95-103, Queues.php:220-236); output escaped with {{ }}; rate limit per entity+user (Serve.php:65-86). Small gaps: `mode` is client-writable and never validated (falls back to `any`), `activeTab` can be set directly to any string (view @else branch then shows invites, still behind @can).

tests.evidence: New tests/Feature/Entity/QueuesTest.php and ServeTest.php cover 403 for employees (route and component), create/duplicate slug, rename slug re-derivation and collision, toggle confirmation, grant/revoke, foreign queue/membership ids, tampered accessQueueId, serve ordering/mode/channel, foreign/unauthorized selection, notices, uncaught authorization, rate limit and locked lastCalledTicketId. Members tab tests added and existing tests adapted to the tab split (EntityInviteTest.php:172-183, MembersTest.php:420-449). No test for a tampered/invalid `mode`, and per-action unauthorized calls in Queues are only covered via mount.

simplicity.evidence: Components are direct and reuse domain actions; waitingTickets mirrors CallNextTicket ordering in a short query (Serve.php:131-151). Some duplication: the same findOrFail+authorize preamble repeated in each Queues method and repeated modal markup in queues.blade.php.

readability.evidence: Clear names, small methods, helpful PHPDoc on untrusted state (Queues.php:35-62) and helpers (addErrorsTo, resetNestedState). Views are long with inline style attributes and an inline @php block computing isManager/hasGrant in the access modal (queues.blade.php:143-146).

scope.evidence: All changes serve the task: two components, views, routes, lang keys, nav, members tabs, adapted tests and docs/CHANGELOG. Extra lang keys (serve_rate_limited, queues_reactivate, etc.) support required UI.

issues.explanation: callMode() uses CallMode::tryFrom(...) ?? CallMode::Any instead of the required CallMode::from($mode), so a tampered mode is silently treated as `any` rather than rejected.
`mode` has #[Validate] but callNext() never calls $this->validate(), so the client-writable property is never validated server-side.
`activeTab` is a public unvalidated property; setting it directly bypasses the setActiveTab whitelist (harmless here since the invites panel is still behind @can).
Four nearly identical modal-card structures and many inline styles could be a reusable anonymous Blade component per the conventions.
rename() silently falls back to viewingQueueId when editingQueueId is null, which makes the state machine less explicit.
No test covers a tampered/invalid `mode` value.

review.summary: The change adds the Queues management page, the Serve panel, members tabs, nav links, lang keys, docs and thorough feature tests, with every client id scoped to the entity and every action going through domain actions and policies. Remaining issues are small: the call mode is not validated and silently falls back to `any` instead of CallMode::from, plus some markup duplication. Approve with nits.
